problems: Hand-off to eu-14-f (teutonic-order, existing dossier, not touched): its 1236, 1249/1253, 1255, 1277 and 1283 gains from the Prussians name 'nobody'; the counterpart should be old-prussians. Old-prussians keeps 1253 for the Warmia/Natangia/Bartia/Pogesania gain (Prussian_Crusade: fighting 'continued intermittently until 1253'); the Treaty of Christburg (7 February 1249) is an autonomy treaty, so eu-14-f should date it 1253 or accept a four-year difference.

Hand-off to eu-14-e (kingdom-of-sweden, existing dossier, not touched): its 1293 and 1323 gains name novgorod-republic, while karelians now files a 1293 loss of the western Isthmus (63 cells, the 90 km Vyborg circle cut to the Isthmus) and a 1323 loss of the West to kingdom-of-sweden; one side should name the other. Counterpart name only, no new dossier.

Hand-off to eu-14-e (livonian-brothers-of-the-sword): the Order's Cliopatria-derived shapes from 1207 cover the archbishopric-of-riga disc and should subtract it; the Brothers' 1206 gain of Turaida from nobody conflicts with the archbishop's disc.

Disagreement with the reviewer on archbishopric-of-riga /ledger 1207: counterpart set to 'nobody', neither livonians nor livonian-brothers-of-the-sword, because neither dossier files a 1207 loss and the pages opened name no donor (Livonians page has no 1206-1208 division).

Disagreement with the reviewer on old-prussians: the new 1260-9 gain carries the exact 110-cell keyframe difference (Sambia, Natangia, Bartia, Warmia, Pogesania), not the whole /ledger/9 region, because Nadruvia, Skalvia and Sudovia were never lost; the same region now sits on the 1260 contest start, 1277 contest end and 1277 loss, and the 1238/1253 rows carry the exact 1253 drop (the old Warmia circle was 29 cells short).

Karelians keyframe 0 was cut from 255,176 km2 to 37,697 km2; North Karelia and the Republic of Karelia are dropped rather than kept as a later band, because the state ends in 1323 and White Karelia is dated to the late 14th century.
